newsitem.title: USA: Fed to release money supply for Dec 16 week on Fri.
newsitem.headline: Fed to release money supply for Dec 16 week on Fri.

text.p: The Federal Reserve will release data on the U.S. money supply for the week ended December 16 on Friday rather than Thursday of this week due to the Christmas holiday, a New York Fed spokesman said.
The figures will be released at the regular 1630 EST/2130 GMT time.
Also, the Fed said its "H.3" report on aggregate reserves of depository institutions and the monetary base will be delayed until Friday at 1630 EST/2130 GMT.

Other reserve data regularly released by the central bank, namely, assets and liabilities of the six major weekly reporting banks in New York City, and factors affecting reserve balances of depository institutions and the condition statement of Federal Reserve banks, will be released on Thursday as usual.
